We wish to inform you that in compliance with the provisions of Regulation 33 read with Regulation 30 of
SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 the Board of Directors at their
meeting held today, i.e. 13th November, 2026 have inter alia approved the following:
1. The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results set out in compliance with applicable Accounting
Standards for the half year ended 30th September, 2026 together with Statement of Assets and
Liabilities.
The Board Meeting commenced at 4:00 P.M. and concluded at 04:40 P.M.
